detail.command: set -euo pipefail; echo '=== ALEXANDER CERT SUBJECTS ==='; security find-certificate -a -c 'Apple Development: Alexander Belov' -p | awk 'BEGIN{n=0}/BEGIN CERTIFICATE/{n++}{print > ("/tmp/wf-cert-" n ".pem")}' || true; for f in /tmp/wf-cert-*.pem; do [ -s "$f" ] || continue; openssl x509 -in "$f" -noout -subject 2>/dev/null || true; done; echo '=== PROVISIONING PROFILES ==='; PROFILE_DIR="$HOME/Library/MobileDevice/Provisioning Profiles"; if [ -d "$PROFILE_DIR" ]; then for p in "$PROFILE_DIR"/*.mobileprovision; do [ -f "$p" ] || continue; tmp=$(mktemp); if security cms -D -i "$p" >"$tmp" 2>/dev/null; then /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c 'Print :Name' "$tmp" 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/Name: /'; /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c 'Print :TeamName' "$tmp" 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/TeamName: /'; /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c 'Print :TeamIdentifier:0' "$tmp" 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/TeamIdentifier: /'; /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c 'Print :Entitlements:application-identifier' "$tmp" 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/AppIdentifier: /'; /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c 'Print :UUID' "$tmp" 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/UUID: /'; /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c 'Print :ExpirationDate' "$tmp" 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/Expires: /'; echo '---'; fi; rm -f "$tmp"; done; else echo 'No provisioning profile directory'; fi
